event.asset: Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) devices, any manufacturer: authorization for a psychotic disorder indication (including auditory hallucinations)
event.title: FDA authorizes a TMS device for psychosis
event.proposition: The FDA authorizes a transcranial magnetic stimulation device for a psychotic disorder indication, including auditory hallucinations.
event.criterion: TRUE on the decision date, in the FDA 510(k), De Novo or PMA database, of a marketing authorization dated after 2026-03-23 for a transcranial magnetic stimulation device whose indications-for-use statement names a psychotic disorder or a symptom of psychosis (for example schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, auditory hallucinations or auditory verbal hallucinations). A breakthrough device designation, a published trial, a professional-society guideline and off-label clinical use are not an authorization. Resolution source: the FDA device databases (510(k), De Novo, PMA). FALSE at the deadline when no such authorization is listed.

resolution_source.name: FDA 510(k), De Novo and PMA databases

readings: 'that's gonna include psychosis' reads as a TMS device authorized for a psychotic disorder indication; auditory hallucinations count as a psychotic symptom.
'and other conditions' names no countable set, so only the psychosis indication is coded.

records.phrase: that's gonna include psychosis ... it's not if it's when
records.stage_note: No TMS submission for a psychosis indication is named at the statement date; no class fits.
records.note: The 'every psychiatrist should use TMS' clause is normative. The coded claim is the extension of TMS to psychosis, which the FDA decides. 'Pretty soon' is not a deadline.
A plan to start a pivotal trial of the Ampa one-day TMS device. Muir is a trial site for Ampa, so his own side decides the trial start.

What Radial brings to its sites is Radial's own decision. Muir is chief scientific officer at Radial.

event.asset: COMP360 (Compass Pathways' synthetic psilocybin) Phase 3 programme in treatment-resistant depression
event.title: A COMP360 Phase 3 trial in treatment-resistant depression meets its primary endpoint
event.proposition: A Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression reports its prespecified primary efficacy endpoint met with statistical significance.
event.criterion: TRUE on the date of the first Compass Pathways topline press release, ClinicalTrials.gov results posting or peer-reviewed publication that reports a Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression as having met its prespecified primary efficacy endpoint with statistical significance against the control arm, as reported by the sponsor. A Phase 2 result, a secondary endpoint, an interim analysis, a long-term follow-up report and a conference abstract without the primary estimate do not count. Resolution source: Compass Pathways topline press releases, with ClinicalTrials.gov results as the secondary source. FALSE at the deadline when the first reported Phase 3 primary endpoint missed significance, or when no Phase 3 primary result is reported.

resolution_source.name: Compass Pathways topline press releases; ClinicalTrials.gov

readings: 'A successful phase three' reads as the prespecified primary efficacy endpoint met with statistical significance.
The first Phase 3 trial to report its primary result resolves the event.

records.phrase: the likelihood of a successful phase three is very very high
records.stage_note: COMP360 is in Phase 3 for treatment-resistant depression at the statement date. No base-rate class covers Phase 3 success alone.
records.note: A qualified likelihood phrase, so bin B. The words give no date and no ClinicalTrials.gov date is available under the blindness rules, so the item is undated. He is an investor in Compass.
'If we produce the clinical data in phase three' is a condition his own company controls, so the conditional is rejected as CONTROL.

event.asset: COMP360 (Compass Pathways' synthetic psilocybin): the first Phase 3 trial readout in treatment-resistant depression
event.title: Compass Pathways reports its first COMP360 Phase 3 readout
event.proposition: Compass Pathways reports topline results, positive or negative, of the first Phase 3 trial of COMP360 in treatment-resistant depression.
event.criterion: TRUE on the date of the first Compass Pathways topline press release, ClinicalTrials.gov results posting or peer-reviewed publication that reports the primary endpoint result, in either direction, of a Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (synthetic psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression. A Phase 2 result, an enrollment or trial-start announcement, a guidance statement on the expected readout date, an interim safety report and a conference abstract without the primary estimate do not count. Resolution source: Compass Pathways press releases, with ClinicalTrials.gov results as the secondary source. FALSE at the deadline when no such report is dated by then.

resolution_source.name: Compass Pathways topline press releases; ClinicalTrials.gov

readings: 'Readout' reads as the sponsor's first public report of the trial's primary endpoint result, in either direction.

records.phrase: going to have the first phase three readout
